widget_mechanic: Calendar opens on current month; agent must click the next-month arrow N times to reach target month, then click the target date cell. The default 'do nothing' leaves the calendar at the current month, producing dates near today (wrong).

primary_inspiration.instruction: can you find me a direct AirAsia flight from Singapore to Langkawi from July 2 to July 5 in economy for 1 person? If there are no available flights, please indicate this in your answer.
primary_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [1.4] Calendar — agent never advanced from the default (May 2026) to July 2026 to select July 2 → July 5; left dates unset / defaulted to the current month.
